rationale: Supported as an exploratory analytical/selection strategy — proceed with the proposed proof-of-concept experiments (rigorous spike-in recovery, orthogonal EV identity assays (EM/density/proteomics), assay-compatibility controls, and reproducibility across ≥3 lots) to resolve capture-specificity, assay-interference, yield, and NHP-bridging gaps. Not ready for CMC adoption or manufacturing commitment until those data and a manufacturability assessment are completed.
